lines: This is Living Textbook.
It brings any page of a school book to life.

scenes.label: On a real book
lines: A page in a school book does not move.
Point your phone at the page.
Now the picture moves, right on the paper.

scenes.label: 1  Open the website
lines: Anyone can try it on the website.
Tap Try now, or use a photo of a page.

scenes.label: 2  Gemini makes the lesson
lines: Here, a student uses a photo of a science page.
Gemini reads every word, number and picture.
It plans the lesson, records a voice, and checks every number against the page.

scenes.label: 3  The tutor teaches
lines: In about twenty seconds, the page is alive.
A tutor made with Gemini Live explains each step.

scenes.label: 4  Ask a question
lines: You can stop the tutor at any time and ask a question.

scenes.label: 5  Try a what-if
lines: Change a number, and the page changes too.

scenes.label: 6  Take the quiz
lines: At the end, a short quiz comes from the text of the page.
A wrong answer shows what the page says.

scenes.label: 7  Keep your progress
lines: Sign in to keep every page.
The progress page shows what you learned.
Gemini suggests what to learn next.

scenes.label: 8  Videos and class films
lines: Teachers can turn a whole chapter into a film for the class.
Students can turn one page into a short video.

scenes.label: 9  Inside other apps
lines: Other learning apps can add all of this with one script tag.
Here, a school website shows a lesson inside its own page.
Living Textbook. Any page, alive.
Built with Gemini on Google Cloud.
